collection.description: A father volunteers to change a baby's cloth for the first time.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a father, volunteers to change a baby's cloth for the first time. The child kicks with astonishing determination, and the clean cloth ends up somewhere entirely unexpected.

choices.label: Ask an Experienced Parent to Demonstrate
Distract the Baby with a Toy
Accept the Mess and Keep Going

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby immediately soils the fresh cloth.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The parent laughs at the situation, then helps without belittling him.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The baby holds still just long enough for him to finish.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The toy lands in the wash basin, followed by a delighted squeal.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He cleans everything up and becomes more confident.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: He needs three cloths and a bath before the task is done.
